title: Add network worker capability handshake
summary: Implement D3 from the network worker hardening plan by reporting worker-accessible library IDs and filtering coordinator dispatch by job library capability.
reason: Workers that cannot access a library should not be handed jobs from that library and then fail/requeue repeatedly.
behavior_before: Worker heartbeats did not report accessible library capabilities, and the coordinator could hand any eligible queued job to any worker regardless of per-library path accessibility.
behavior_after: Workers report accessible_library_ids from their local library path checks, coordinator registry rows retain that capability evidence, dispatch skips jobs whose library_id is not accessible to the requesting worker, and the Network WebView shows per-worker capability evidence.
